tools.name: ask_site_assistant
tools.description: Ask this website's chat assistant a question on the visitor's behalf. The turn is shown in the chat window and the assistant's reply is returned.

message.description: What the visitor wants to ask or say.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search this company's open jobs through the site chat assistant. Optionally describe the role, location, or keywords.

query.description: Role, location, or keywords, e.g. "forklift operator in Dallas".

tools.name: start_application
tools.description: Start a job application in the site chat. The assistant collects details in the chat window and the visitor confirms before anything is submitted.

job_title.description: Title of the job to apply for.

job_id.description: Job id from a job listing, if known.
